reason: I make about a thousand dollars a month, and $19 to $45 every month is real money when my clients pay me a flat fee no matter how many receipts they send. I might play with the 40 free documents, but I'd go back to chasing receipts by hand before I'd start paying.
objection: My clients won't want a bot sitting in their group chats reading everything their staff post. If I can't put it in the group, I'm just forwarding receipts to it myself, and that's barely less work than typing them into my sheet.
would_change_my_mind: A plan around $5 a month for a solo bookkeeper with a few clients, plus proof that clients are fine with the bot in their chats, like a short message I could send them explaining what it sees and keeps.
